listAllAssets.title: List All Assets
listAllAssets.description: Ingest every workbook and data model in the Sigma organization. By default, Sigma's API lists only the workbooks and data models that the owner of the client credentials can access. When on, the connector adds Sigma's skipPermissionCheck=true parameter to both listings, and excludeExplorations=true to the workbook listing so that private custom views are not ingested. Sigma accepts skipPermissionCheck only from a user with the Admin account type.
